description: Canonical storage-marker/pending contract cases for UPeg's split-v2 storage layout. Owned by upeg-core; other ecosystem repos implementing or consuming the same on-disk contract (storage-layout.json / .storage-migration.json) vendor this directory and assert the same outcomes against their own reader/writer. UPeg's own ground truth for these cases is upeg-core/tests/storage_contract.rs, which loads this file and drives upeg_core::paths against real fixtures on disk.

placeholders.ROOT: Replaced with the absolute path of the case's own fresh temporary root directory before the fixture JSON is parsed or written to disk.
placeholders.TARGET: Replaced with the absolute path of the case's own fresh temporary target directory. Only present in cases that also set target_marker.

cases.description: A plain split-v2 marker with no target/migration_id (never migrated, or already the final destination of one) resolves to itself.
A redirect-v2 marker at ROOT and a split-v2 marker at TARGET that share the same migration_id: resolving ROOT must follow the redirect and land on TARGET as split-v2.
B1: a redirect-v2 marker whose migration_id does not match the target's split-v2 marker must be refused, not silently followed.
A root with split-layout content (data/toolkits) but no storage-layout.json marker is ambiguous and must be refused rather than silently adopted.
A root with only a flat upeg.db and no marker and no split-layout artifacts resolves as an ordinary legacy-v1 root.
B4: a pending sidecar whose status is "inactive" (a retired/rolled-back-or-aborted migration) must not block resolution; the root resolves normally, uniformly across platforms.
A pending sidecar with no status key (a live, in-progress migration) must block resolution with a dedicated pending error.
A marker whose raw JSON text repeats an object key (here "app") is rejected outright rather than resolved by last-value-wins.
schema_version must be the JSON integer 1, not a float that happens to print the same (1.0).
schema_version must be the JSON integer 1, not a boolean.
layout must be exactly "split-v2" or "redirect-v2"; any other value is rejected.
A marker object key outside the fixed allow-list (schema_version, app, layout, root, target, migration_id) is rejected.
The marker's own "root" field must equal the directory it was actually read from; a mismatch (stale copy, hand-edit, or move) is rejected.

Documents the expected marker shape for a Windows APPDATA-rooted legacy path. Not exercised by upeg-core/tests/storage_contract.rs, which runs on Unix CI only; a Windows-side consumer of this fixture set should assert this resolves as split-v2 with root equal to the literal backslash path.
